title: Feed the starter
thesis: The slow invisible part of the work decides the result, long before anyone sees it.

nodes.text: Teams reward the visible part of the work and starve the part that decides it.

evidence.filled_by: the bakery's first month: no shaping, only feeding

nodes.text: The failure happens hours before anyone touches the dough, so nobody sees its cause.

evidence.filled_by: 'You can't rescue bad fermentation with good scoring.'

nodes.text: Give new people a month on the starter, and keep the notebook that lets you read the failure back.

evidence.filled_by: the month of feeding; eleven years of notebooks

nodes.text: It looks like hazing to the people doing it.

evidence.filled_by: the early-shift baker who hated the first month

nodes.text: The moment you know someone will be good is when they notice the starter.

evidence.filled_by: adjusting the water on rainy days
